# Rescue Fill Dialog
RescueFillDialog is the Vue popup component used by ZenTao task 2942 to select warning item and property management area before rescue workorder filling.

## Role And Structure
- Reuses StageFilterDialog, a reusable filter dialog component for pre-fill selection; reuse was confirmed by checking StageFilterDialog references, rescue APIs, and deployment config.
- Shows flood warning plus property area; at RescueFillDialog.vue:13-22 the selected area starts empty, and before the fix L48-57 required choosing a warning item first.
- complexSeq at RescueFillDialog.vue:33-45 handles the area-loading race; the existing mechanism was retained instead of adding a new one.

## Area Loading Changes
- On 2026-11-26 hop3 applied five changes: loadComplex passes useCommonApi=true.
- openAreaDropdown/toggleAreaDropdown removed the eventId gate; pickAlert no longer clears an already selected area when switching warning items.
- The area template input removed eventId-dependent disabled/placeholder text; onMounted proactively loads authorized areas once.
- The rescue area dropdown must use /common/complex/page (flood.ts:527-537), not /plan/complexPage; LoginUserInfo has no area field.

## API And Deployment
- `usePortalApi()` requests lists only when API base is non-empty and token exists; preview build sets `VITE_API_BASE_URL=/api` and intercepts responses; deployment must set `VITE_API_BASE_URL` or `VITE_AUTH_BASE_URL`; learning/news come from fixtures and field mapping is unverified by real API.
- `request(..., {raw:true})` returns `{code,msg,data}` for caller unwrap, while default unwraps data; `portal.ts detail()` unwraps; `GET /v2.0/system/region/list(parentCode=320500)` is login-free and returns `JsonResult<List<SysRegionVo>>` with `{regionName,regionCode,level,parentCode}`; 2026-11-11 added `getKeyData/getBenefitData/getRepairData/getSunshineOverview/getRegionList` in the same pattern.
- nginx uses port 8095 upstream `192.168.1.31`; local backend changes usually do not affect real-device verification; local backend `mvn compile` needs sibling API jars `zhi2-property-api` and `common-framework-api` installed in the local Maven repo.

# ZenTao Task 2942
Zentao task 2942 is the rescue-workorder fill popup development task for property management area and warning-item selection.

## Requirements And Decisions
- Task number 2942; link `http://zentao-biz.zhi.com/index.php?m=task&f=view&id=2942`; title "求援工单填报弹窗（物业管理区域 + 预警事项）".
- Before filling a workorder, a popup selects "物业管理区域 + 预警事项".
- Three Zentao requirements: property users see their area's data; property area defaults from the account's selected area, remains selectable, and choices are authorized areas; contact/phone autofill and are editable.
- Attachments fileID 24508/24509/24523 show "请先选择预警事项", conflicting with the written "default current login area" requirement.
